title: Make implement-ticket.js parse under the native Workflow runtime and remove Date.now
summary: Escaped two raw-backtick sites in implement-ticket.js prompts and removed the Date.now fallback; executionId suffix can come from args. Parse pinned in test_workflow_runtime_acorn_parse.py; 506 tests pass.

title: Design and prototype verifiable gate results for agent-run commands in a native workflow
summary: Prototyped nonce-hash attestation; a cheat-instructed subagent forged it first try. Recommend adopt for gates only plus orchestrator re-run and CI backstop. Evidence and cost in design.md.

title: Port the 23 advisory and bookkeeping bash sites to args/runCommand and decide dispatch batching
summary: Added legacyBash/sh/shOmit runtime-aware helpers to implement-ticket.js and ported 23 advisory and bookkeeping sites; legacy path unchanged; batching decision recorded (drops ~24 dispatches per native run). 1056 tests pass.

title: Port the input-class bash sites to runCommand
summary: Ported 4 input and 2 plain control sites via sh(); native runtime requires start_ts and execution_id_suffix args (INVALID_ARGS otherwise); legacy path unchanged. 1058 tests pass.
